title: Fire (notes from a control)
description: Plays a note when a control passes a level, once for every time it does (a car passes, a hit plays), with a minimum time between two notes.

outputs.name: notes
outputs.title: Notes
outputs.description: One note for each time the control passes the threshold.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off makes a control that stays at the low end of the range.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.doc: The level that fires a note (a general control runs from 0 to 1; a typed one uses its own unit).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.doc: rising fires when the control goes above the threshold, falling when it goes below.

parameters.name: note
parameters.doc: The pitch (MIDI number, 60 is the middle C).

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.doc: How hard the note is played: a number from 1 to 127, or level to take it from the control at that moment.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.doc: The least time between two notes (a car that wobbles around the threshold fires once).
